item: Restore carries the live settings into the copy before the swap
summary: _carry_live_settings upserts the live settings rows (settings.*, agenda.*, ui.*, and the search history through its own module) into the working copy after the checkpoint and before swap_in_corpus, so a setting written after the snapshot (migration, a save during a long import, a carried group copy) survives the swap; record-about-table keys stay with the snapshot; the save-between-read-and-replace gap is stated and recorded.
